title: The setup page shows at once, each check on its own
text: On a first start, Seismic checks which coding agents are installed and signed in. The setup page now appears immediately, and each agent is checked in its own request, with a spinner beside its name until it answers. git, which every agent needs, is checked separately too, so a slow git never delays an agent's result. An agent you have not touched is ticked once it is found ready; one you ticked or unticked yourself keeps your choice. Each agent, and git, has its own Check again.
chapters: Before: one wait for every check
Now: the page at once, a spinner per agent
git is checked on its own
Ticked before the check: stays on
Each agent checks again on its own
Unticked before the check: stays off

more.title: A failed setup check can be retried
more.text: When Seismic can't finish checking an agent or git in the Setup dialog, it now says so right there and offers a Check again button for that check alone. Before, a check that failed the first time showed nothing to retry, so that agent was left unchecked. The agents you've ticked stay ticked while you retry.
